authority_used: Accepted Goal86 Run and continuation; scoped source/tests/guidance, private evidence and required projections; owned local fault fixtures; no external or publication authority used.
implementation: Strong graph-writer lock provenance binds a random owner nonce, PID, exact checkout, local boot/user/namespace context, transaction and issued directory epoch.
Read-only graph recover inspection issues mode-specific --lock-evidence only after exact graph/control/dependency/journal/lock review and same-environment absent-owner proof.
Same-tip exclusive claim publication keeps the original lock directory continuously present; claims and lock epochs persist in the private journal without rewriting immutable graph receipts.
Complete unmirrored claims can be inspected after a killed recovery; recorded rollback intent cannot become resume.
Per-write/save/terminal guards retain exact lock and selected/other journal custody; terminal readiness agrees with execution.
Normal reentrancy rechecks custody; checked nonrecursive release preserves unknown or replaced lock evidence.
limitations: Not universal power-loss recovery: incomplete owner/claim/journal publication, journal temporary residue and partial cleanup remain fail-closed without inferred authority.
Weak historical orphan locks, unavailable OS evidence, live/suspended/reused PIDs, foreign checkout/boot/user/namespace and ambiguous liveness refuse.
No malicious same-user pathname-race or ACL-preservation clearance. Those remain explicit independent audit/qualification gates.

Intermediate macOS arm64 proof only; final 0.6.0 Linux x86_64/arm64, complete installed matrix, fresh Standard, independent complete-remediation review, full release ladder and artifact seal remain open.
